non_blocking: packages/commands/src/commands/task.ts dependenciesNextLine: in the branch where the task could already run before the change (wasRunnable), the done sentence appends previewWork's read-only line through afterMove. With the hands-off setting on and no session running, previewWork returns 'A session started for it (this project starts by itself when work is ready).', so the sentence claims a start that did not happen (§5 rule 9). afterDependenciesLine also maps that preview to 'at your next Start'. Both are narrow (the setting is off by default) and are siblings of withPreview's read-backs.

needOfLine (depth.ts) also matches status questions such as 'how long has it been in review for?' ('review for') or 'how does this compare?', so the app puts a paid ask line under a quick status answer. The ask spends nothing. LC-C13 on bench-live should check for false asks on plain questions.

executor.confirm's new closedProjectRefusal has no test that fails without it: redecide already re-runs prepare's refuseClosedProject for chat and Inbox cards, and the restart case was fixed by restorePending. The guard only adds cover for the Undo path (its redecide does not prepare), and that path has no test. A composed card that spans two projects has projectId null, so this guard skips it; redecide's per-step guard still refuses it.

L4-chat-201: yesCovers is untested defense in depth (the cases pass with only atMostOf's centime rounding). A floor that crosses a centime boundary between the ask and the Go ahead still asks once more with a figure 1 centime higher. The optional floor-without-the-ask-line is in not_done.

The 201 real-daemon case says that with cheap estimates the 'at most' equals the pass's floor, the pass reaches its wrap-up and the strongest model is offered under the Go ahead answer. On bench-live (LC-C14), check that a stronger Go ahead does not routinely end with 'This needs the strongest model … Go ahead?'.

withoutWordsOffer removes every sentence matching 'stronger model' or 'hand it over', not only questions. An answer that both mentions 'Sonnet is a stronger model.' and asks in words loses the plain sentence too.

Restart cases for the stepped history window and the Go ahead recreate the agent on the same in-memory store (w.restart()), not composeRuntime twice on one home (validation rule 4's preferred form; same convention as the file's earlier cases). My bench walk restarted the real daemon and the past-tense lines and a fresh ask held.
